settings.title: Full-Option Industrial Glass Washing Machine 1800mm – Iran

settings.text:
If you have ever seen a double-glazed glass production line up close, you will know that one of the most important stages in the production process is washing the glass using a glass washing machine.
These machines are essential because even the smallest stain trapped on the glass surface may become impossible to remove once the double-glazed window production process is complete, as the inner surface will no longer be accessible.
The Full-Option Industrial Glass Washing Machine 1800mm – Iran is a highly practical solution for this purpose. In this article, we will introduce its specifications and features.

settings.title: Why Is a Double-Glazed Glass Washing Machine Necessary?
settings.text:
It is common to find double-glazed glass workshops using traditional methods to clean glass.
This is one of the major mistakes in the production process, as it has a significant effect on the final quality and, in particular, the cleanliness of the finished product.
With traditional methods, drying is not carried out properly using an air-drying system in a double-glazed glass washing machine. As a result, stains remain on the glass and become clearly visible under light after installation, indicating poor production quality.
In addition to grease stains, which are very difficult to remove using traditional methods, fabric lint may also remain on the glass.
Using a washing machine eliminates these problems through washing with high-temperature water and air drying.
Other benefits include lower water consumption, faster washing and, consequently, higher production capacity.
Glass washing speeds can reach 5 linear metres per minute. This high speed makes the cost of a double-glazed glass washing machine a worthwhile investment.

settings.title: How Does a Double-Glazed Glass Washing Machine Work?
settings.text:
The glass washing process begins when the operator manually places the glass at the machine inlet or loads it using loading tables.
The machine's control panel has a set of buttons. When the start button is pressed, the rollers move the glass into the washing section.
Once inside, the glass is washed with hot water and scratch-resistant brushes, then rinsed.
After washing, the glass, free of grease and dirt, enters the drying section. There, high-pressure warm air dries it without leaving stains before it is conveyed to the machine outlet.
The control panel also includes other buttons and functions, such as displaying the water temperature, switching the water pumps, drying blowers, water and air heating elements on and off, adjusting the glass feed speed, and more.

settings.title: Types of Double-Glazed Glass Washing Machines
settings.text:
There are generally two types of industrial glass washing machines:
1. Vertical glass washing machines, available for glass heights of 1800, 2000 and 2200 mm.
2. Horizontal glass washing machines, available for glass widths of 1200, 1600, 1800, 2000 and 2500 mm.
